photos_research.curation_result: Of the 12 raw IG posts, most carried baked-in caption text, InShot watermarks, a picture-in-picture inset, a press-clip banner, or showed a mid-procedure closed-eyes acupuncture shot (prohibited by gallery curation rules). 6 usable derivative images were produced by cropping out the text/logo/watermark regions from the clean underlying photos: hero-1.jpg (cupping treatment), about-1.jpg (studio interior candid), about-2.jpg (hot stone massage hands), avatar.jpg (therapist portrait, cropped from a Voyage MIA press photo, used ONLY as small avatar per gallery rules), gallery-1.jpg (studio shelf/desk ambiance, distinct crop from about-1.jpg source), gallery-3.jpg (welcome mat at studio entrance).
